summary.text: ARCTICPRODUCTS AS is a private limited company registered in Kvalsund, founded 2017-02-07. ArcticProducts AS is a wholesaler that imports and sells gift items, outdoor equipment and fishing equipment related to fishing and outdoor life to shops and retail outlets. Retail sales of the same products through an online shop are planned to become a secondary activity, alongside guiding in hunting, fishing and outdoor life and related activities such as renting out cabins. It was previously named ARCTIC IMPORT AS until 2018-04-26. Its main industry code is 46.490: wholesale of other household goods. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 4 268 102 NOK and the annual result was 188 697 NOK; operating income was down from 4 493 761 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 177 587 NOK in 2024 to 188 697 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 1 066 741 NOK in 2024 to 1 255 438 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Sivert Ribe Jacobsen (styrets leder), with 2 other board members. Its verified website is arcticflies.no. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
